entities.name: Late Antiquity
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The transitional period (c. 250-750 CE) between the Classical world and the Middle Ages, encompassing the decline of the Western Roman Empire, the rise of Christianity and Islam, the Germanic migrations, and the emergence of the Byzantine, Sassanid, and early Islamic civilizations. Modern scholarship views Late Antiquity as a period of transformation rather than simple decline.
